description: UoA-UW Reinforced Concrete Wall Database is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Alex Shegay, University of Auckland (aucklanduni.ac.nz). The database in this publication is a collection of experimental data on 142 reinforced concrete walls, including data on the wall characteristics and expermental results. The database was compiled by several researchers at the Univeristy of Auckland (UOA) and University of Washington (UW). Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-r12q-t415. Keywords: RC walls, ductile walls, earthquakes, wall database. Published 2021-08-13. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
